title: Devil Summoner: Soul Hackers / Ronde
native_title: デビル・サマナー ソウル・ハッカーズ／輪舞曲
overview:
Ronde
You can play from the beginning through stage 3.

Devil Summoner: Soul Hackers
You can view previously unreleased movies.

This not-for-sale Atlus sample disc previews two upcoming Megami Tensei titles.

Ronde is a tactical simulation RPG and a sequel to Majin Tensei II. The trial lets you play its opening stages, with battles laid out over a city map.

Devil Summoner: Soul Hackers is a cyberpunk RPG set in a high-tech model city built around the virtual reality network Paradigm-X. You play a member of the hacker group the Spookies who obtains a gun-shaped computer that summons demons. The disc offers movies from the game to watch.
